title: Could, was able to, managed to
summary: Nói về khả năng trong quá khứ và việc làm được trong một lần cụ thể: could, was able to, managed to, couldn't.

dialogue.en: How was the trip to Ha Giang?
dialogue.vi: Chuyến đi Hà Giang thế nào?

dialogue.en: Amazing! But the roads were very difficult.
dialogue.vi: Tuyệt lắm! Nhưng đường khó đi lắm.

dialogue.en: [[Were]] you [[able to]] drive the whole way?
dialogue.vi: Bạn có lái được hết đường không?

dialogue.en: No. It rained, but we [[managed to]] reach Dong Van.
dialogue.vi: Không. Trời mưa, nhưng cuối cùng bọn mình cũng tới được Đồng Văn.

dialogue.en: I [[couldn't]] ride a motorbike when I was younger.
dialogue.vi: Hồi trẻ mình không biết đi xe máy.

dialogue.en: Really? I [[could]] ride when I was twelve.
dialogue.vi: Thật à? Mình biết đi từ năm mười hai tuổi.

sections.heading: Could: biết, có khả năng trong quá khứ
sections.rule: **could + V** = **biết, có khả năng** làm gì trong quá khứ nói chung (một khoảng thời gian).

examples.vi: Ông tôi biết nói tiếng Pháp.
examples.why: Khả năng chung trong quá khứ.

examples.en: When I was five, I [[could]] swim.
examples.vi: Năm tuổi tôi đã biết bơi.
examples.why: Khả năng trong một giai đoạn.

check.prompt: When she was young, she ___ dance very well.

sections.heading: Was able to, managed to: làm được trong một lần
sections.rule: **Một lần cụ thể** đã làm được (thường có khó khăn) → **was / were able to** hoặc **managed to**, **không** dùng could.
body: *Managed to* nhấn mạnh **khó khăn** mà vẫn làm được. Tiếng Việt: *cuối cùng cũng…, xoay xở được*.
Ở **phủ định** thì dùng **couldn't** được cho cả hai trường hợp: *I couldn't open the door.*

examples.en: The exam was hard, but I [[was able to]] finish it.
examples.vi: Bài thi khó nhưng tôi đã làm xong.
examples.why: Một lần cụ thể → was able to (không dùng could).

examples.en: After three hours, we [[managed to]] fix the car.
examples.vi: Sau ba tiếng, cuối cùng chúng tôi cũng sửa được xe.
examples.why: Khó khăn nhưng làm được → managed to.

examples.en: I [[couldn't]] find my keys this morning.
examples.vi: Sáng nay tôi không tìm được chìa khóa.

check.prompt: The fire was big, but everyone ___ escape.
check.explain: Một lần cụ thể làm được → was able to.

sections.heading: Be able to ở các thì khác
sections.rule: **can** chỉ có hiện tại và **could**. Ở các thì khác dùng **be able to**: will be able to, have been able to.

examples.en: [[I'll be able to]] help you tomorrow.
examples.vi: Mai tôi sẽ giúp bạn được.
examples.why: Tương lai → will be able to (không nói will can).

examples.en: I [[haven't been able to]] sleep well lately.
examples.vi: Dạo này tôi không ngủ ngon được.
examples.why: Hiện tại hoàn thành → have been able to.

check.explain: Tương lai → will be able to.

mistakes.wrong: The test was hard but I could pass it.
mistakes.right: The test was hard but I was able to pass it.
mistakes.why: Một lần cụ thể làm được → was able to.

mistakes.right: I will be able to come tomorrow.
mistakes.why: Không dùng will can → will be able to.

mistakes.right: She managed to finish the race.
I haven't been able to sleep.
mistakes.why: Hiện tại hoàn thành → have been able to.

mistakes.wrong: We were able open the door.
mistakes.right: We were able to open the door.

exercises.prompt: He ___ read when he was four.
exercises.explain: Khả năng chung trong quá khứ → could.

exercises.prompt: It was hard, but we ___ get tickets for the concert.
exercises.explain: Một lần cụ thể, khó khăn → managed to.

exercises.prompt: I ___ find a parking space, so I was late.
After many tries, she ___ to open the jar.
answers: managed

exercises.prompt: They ___ able to finish the project on time.
answers: were

exercises.prompt: I haven't ___ able to call her yet.
answers: been

exercises.prompt: My father ___ play the guitar when he was young.
answers: could

exercises.prompt: Don't worry. You'll ___ able to do it.
answers: be

exercises.vi: Cuối cùng chúng tôi cũng tìm được khách sạn.
alternatives: In the end we managed to find the hotel.

exercises.vi: Tôi sẽ có thể giúp bạn vào ngày mai.
alternatives: Tomorrow I will be able to help you.

exercises.sentence: The road was flooded but we could get home in the end.
answers: The road was flooded but we managed to get home in the end.
exercises.explain: Một lần cụ thể → managed to.

exercises.sentence: She will can speak English soon.
answers: She will be able to speak English soon.
He managed to pass the exam.
I could swim when I was a child.
When I was a child, I could swim.
I could swim when I was young.
When I was young, I could swim.
I could swim when I was little.
When I was little, I could swim.
I was able to swim when I was a child.

exercises.vi: Bài thi khó nhưng tôi vẫn làm xong.
answers: The exam was hard, but I managed to finish it.
The exam was hard but I managed to finish it.
The test was hard, but I managed to finish it.
The exam was difficult, but I managed to finish it.
The exam was hard, but I was able to finish it.
The test was difficult, but I managed to finish it.
The test was hard, but I was able to finish it.
The exam was difficult, but I was able to finish it.
exercises.explain: Một lần cụ thể → managed to / was able to.
